question: Your alarm rings at 7am. You have an important exam today, but you stayed up late studying. What do you do?

options.text: Hit snooze and skip the exam
Get up, eat a proper breakfast, and head out on time
Stay in bed and cram on your phone
Get up late and grab a snack on the way

question: A classmate asks to copy your homework because they ran out of time. What do you do?

options.text: Say no and walk away
Let them copy the whole thing
Let them look at just one answer
Say no, but offer to explain the topic so they can do it themselves

question: You find a wallet with cash and an ID on the school corridor floor. What do you do?

options.text: Pick it up and keep it safe until you can find out whose it is
Leave it where it is
Hand it in to the front office so it can be returned
Keep the whole wallet

question: You have a group project due Friday and your teammates are not replying to messages. What do you do?

options.text: Remove their names from the project
Wait until Thursday and hope they reply
Quietly do all the work yourself
Check in again, share your progress, and ask your teacher for help if needed

question: You have saved up some money. Your phone is working fine, but a new model just launched. What do you do?

options.text: Keep your current phone and put the money into savings
Spend it all on snacks for the week
Buy the new phone on credit right away
Treat yourself to something small and save the rest
